formula: baseline external UN cost minus intervention external UN cost
amount_encoding: Finite decimal strings in currency units; unknown amount null with missing_reason; never binary floats.
sign_convention: External charges positive and authenticated external credits negative; internal payer charge nonnegative, provider recovery nonpositive.
internal_elimination: Every internal_pair_id has exactly one equal-and-opposite charge/recovery, distinct counterpart entities, and a transfer_id; remove both entries once. External provider expenditure remains.
component_rule: Unique cost_object_id plus component_id within each scenario; included parent and child cannot both enter totals.
coverage_rule: Both scenarios explicitly attest all affected entities and full components with a receipt, no omitted components; zero requires a source receipt.
recognition: Calculator produces unvalidated scenario differences only. No candidate promotion, cashable classification or realized-savings recognition.
unimplemented_scope: Discounting, multi-period schedules and cash/accrual reconciliation require separate reviewed models.
Aggregation across cases requires benefit-pool and scenario compatibility receipts.
